programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: John Ransom gets thrown out of the village pub in Midsomer Mere, for fighting with his brother-in-law, and a short while later he is found dead on the green. It is discovered that John had been used as a guinea pig for scientific experiments by his brother Max, who suspected he had the ability of 'Second Sight'. Barnaby and Scott soon discover that another family possesses the same talent. They have to delve deeper to unravel many secrets within the village to find the truth.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When solicitor Nick Turner apparently commits suicide by walking off the roof of his home in Midsomer Magna, then Nick's neighbour Jack Wilmot mysteriously disappears that same day, it starts a series of unexplained events. Barnaby and Scott soon discover that a large amount of money has gone missing from the account of one of Nick's clients. Shortly afterwards, Nick's rival gets murdered in an elaborate ritual, by his own model of a medieval catapult, while his wife is forced to watch.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The body of a visitor is found on-site at the famous relish factory of Plummer & Son in the village of Little Upton. When the detectives begin investigating the Plummer family and its staff, it turns out that the victim, Dexter Lockwood, was known to the family and had been on a guided tour of the factory the day before his body was found. It is not long before legal documents, family resentments and mysterious sightings add to the complexity of the case.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Retired music teacher Arthur Leggott is murdered after disturbing an intruder at his home in Badger's Drift. It is discovered that a musical manuscript by the late composer Joan Alder has since gone missing before being sent to auction. When the manuscript shows signs that it has been written by another hand, a handwritten letter by Joan Alder turns up indicating the manuscript is a forgery. Where the manuscript goes more murders follow.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Peter and Caroline Cave are house-hunting in Midsomer Newton, when they hear about a house called Winyard; a tumbledown cottage in the woods. At the estate agents they get informed "that the house is not yet available for viewing". They view the house a short time later by themselves anyway. The following morning they are both found dead in their car, near the house. DCI Barnaby and Acting DC Ben Jones enter a world of property developers, eccentric villagers, estate agents and ghost stories.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Midsomer Barton, the villagers are all celebrating the annual Oak Apple Week. After the body of a woman is found in a stream, the return of the carnival queen event, after a hiatus of eight years, is speculated to be the reason for a series of murders. With recognisable faces from the past, drunken boasts, hidden obsessions and secret loves, Barnaby and Jones try to restore peace and harmony to the village.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The wealthy, eccentric and obese Sir Freddy Butler drops dead, shortly after gathering all three of his wives to Haddington Hall to make an announcement. George Bullard tells Barnaby that the death was from natural causes. The case gets more complex when Freddy's solicitor is deliberately killed in an arson attack on his home and Freddy's will goes missing.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Midsomer Worthy, council clerk Martin Barrett is shot to death through his kitchen window, while a mystery woman settles in, in the spare room upstairs. Barnaby and Jones discover Barrett was a skillful blackmailer, and believe his murderer to be one of his victims. The investigation takes Barnaby and Joyce to the seaside at Fennacombe Bay and Jones to question Sir John Waverley.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A 90-year-old feud between the male and female inhabitants of Broughton once again comes to a head with an event known as the Skimmington Ride. When elderly Ms Danvers is poisoned a short time before the event takes place. Barnaby and Jones have to investigate whether it was to do with the feud, a long held buried secret, or something else. This looks more likely when the Rev. Anthony Gant is shot and killed whilst taking part in the traditional ride. Before another villager ends up dead.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Villagers of Eleverton-cum-Latterly are divided over the building of a new supermarket development. Shortly after a heated meeting, Frank Hopkirk, an independent environmental supervisor is found stabbed at Jubb's timber yard, the site of the new supermarket, by a pair of children. When Barnaby and Jones investigate they find he came to the village for secret rendezvous with various female villagers in fantasy role-playing scenarios.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Midsomer Worthy is gearing up for the Four Choirs Competition, when one of their members, Connor Simpson, is found dead at his home. Barnaby and Jones begin to look into the events leading to his death. The case is further complicated, when a birdwatcher and estate keeper is also killed. After it is found he had been photographing suspicious activity, an attempted murder is interrupted.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Around a year ago, Annie Woodrow was arrested and accused of the murder of her best friend, Frances Trevelyan, on the motive of fondness for Frances's husband. As Annie's trial begins, DCI Barnaby is uncertain of her guilt. A chance remark by Frances's youngest daughter and meeting with an old friend in psychiatry, makes him reevaluate the evidence for her conviction.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A disused airfield at Cooper's Cross is where Simon Bright's vintage car is found by Frances Kirby. Inside she finds Simon dead, as the evening before his death had been on a romantic date with his girlfriend Laura Sharp. Laura is nowhere to be found, both Barnaby and Jones, newly promoted to DS, need to work out if it was a suicide pact gone wrong or whether it was murder and track down Laura.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Faith Alexander arrives in Midsomer to meet her long-lost uncle Rex Masters. She receives a real shock, when she discovers that Rex's friends had been told she had died in a plane crash. Things become complicated when Rex's body is found in the nearby river. Barnaby and Jones quickly turn up trying to workout who would wish Rex harm. Several friends of Rex come forward with multiple 'new' wills each being sole beneficiary.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: After escaping the bonds of slavery, Bass Reeves takes refuge among the indigenous people of The Indian Territory, where he is welcomed into their culture. When the Civil War ends, his new-found tracking skills and fluency in native languages lead to his appointment as the first Black Deputy U.S. Marshal west of the Mississippi River. Though he faces discrimination from his peers, Reeves earns their respect when he accepts Judge Isaac Parker's daunting order to hunt down one of the most ruthless killers in The Indian Territory and bring him back dead or alive. Some years later, Bat Masterson, legendary gunfighter-turned-newspaperman, interviews Judge Parker to learn more about the amazing career of Bass Reeves, who goes on to arrest 3,000 felons, kill 14 men in self-defense, and complete 32 years of service without being wounded.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.sub-title: Wild Bill Hickok & the First Quick-Draw Duel
programme.desc: Wild Bill Hickok and his buddy, Davis Tutt, see their friendship fall apart over gambling debts and the affections of a beautiful woman. After Tutt swipes Wild Bill's prized timepiece as payback for a disputed debt, things begin to heat up. Then, when Tutt parades through town with the watch in one hand and Hickok's former girlfriend in the other, Wild Bill's blood begins to boil. Tutt refuses to return the watch, and he continues to flaunt the beautiful woman on his arm. The two men meet in the middle of town to settle their differences once and for all in what will become the very first quick-draw duel of the Old West. Both men reach for their pistols at the same time and fire! In an attempt to separate the truth from the fiction, Bat Masterson, legendary gunfighter-turned-newspaperman, interviews George Ward Nichols, the journalist who immortalized the duel and created the legend of Wild Bill Hickok.

programme.desc: Sharecropper Gabe Fenway enters his horse, Sapphire, in a race. His landlord, Jake Preston, bets Fenway that Mark's horse, Blueboy, will win. Preston wants Fenway's farm and bets $1000 against his whole year of crops. He will stop at nothing to win.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Bessie Steel Weaver welcomes her husband, Farley, home after his release from prison. Lucas hires him as a hand believing he has changed his ways. However, when a murder occurs during a local robbery, suspicions are aroused.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas' old Army buddy, Tom Benton, comes to North Fork raising a ruckus. Micah arrests him and Lucas bails him out. Benton, an undercover federal agent, wants to stay in jail to hopefully infiltrate a gang of bank robbers.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way
programme.desc: Bubba's back in the saddle with the guys when his horse bucks and throws him on a bone-breaking fall, fractures his cowboy spirit and immobilizes his work with the cattle company. Booger enlists a bullfighter to help him wrangle his ornery Brahman cattle, and considers whether or not he has enough land to maintain the growing herd. Misty gives Cody a gift from the heart that captures both their past as a couple and honors their growing family legacy as ranchers. The guys pitch each other competing ideas for their future steakhouse, and Cody's brainstorm stands out as the one with true cowboy vision - including a name for their venture.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way
programme.desc: Bubba's in a pinch when Cody urges him to ease his aching back with acupuncture. Cody and Misty have to find out why their herd is losing so many stillborn calves before it threatens their new business. Booger discovers the ups and downs of daddy duty when he takes care of Matthew for the day. He draws on the bonding time he had with his own grandfather to make a special new memory. The cowboys put their steakhouse dreams on the line to recruit a business partner and are confronted with their next steps: developing a full menu and creating a pop-up restaurant.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A young, naïve woman who doesn't have any business experience comes to North Fork and purchases the general store from Hattie Denton. A newcomer and his partner con her by posing as collection agents, putting the town's citizens in danger.

programme.title: The Rifleman

programme.title: F Troop
programme.desc: Top brass at the Army's War Department choose Fort Courage as a testing site for a new bulletproof vest. However, spies soon infiltrate the fort and hamper the success of their test. Captain Parmenter must deal with this serious situation.

programme.title: F Troop
programme.desc: O'Rourke and Agarn scheme to get Captain Parmenter to move off the post by playing matchmaker for him and Wrangler Jane. After several failed attempts, the two schemers stage a fake romance between Jane and Agarn, hoping to make Parmenter jealous.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.sub-title: Dr. Susan Anderson: Frontier Medicine Woman
programme.desc: Freshly-graduated from medical school, Dr. Susan Anderson sets up a practice in Cripple Creek, Colorado, a rough-and-tumble mining town. At a time when only ten percent of physicians are female, Dr. Anderson faces her share of doubters and has a difficult time attracting patients in the frontier town. When miners suddenly rush into her office with an injured boy, she defies prevailing wisdom and decides to save his mangled arm instead of amputating the limb. The risks are enormous. If the boy's arm becomes infected, and he dies, she will lose everything. Years later, Dr. Anderson relives the story while treating Bat Masterson, legendary gunfighter-turned-newspaperman, who comes down with fever while passing through Cripple Creek.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: Just days on the job and brandishing a homemade badge, nineteen-year-old Deputy Elfego Baca's courage is immediately put to the test. After arresting a drunken cowboy for shooting up a saloon, Baca faces down the cowboy's friends, who are hired guns for a wealthy rancher. He wins the first skirmish, but the cowboys return with reinforcements and the stage is set for the biggest and longest gunfight in Old West history. Baca seeks shelter in a small adobe house and makes his stand against a small army of men who shoot up the house with thousands of rounds of ammunition over the course of 33 hours. Years later, legendary gunfighter-turned-newspaperman Bat Masterson gets the real story of what comes to be known as the Frisco Shootout from the former sheriff who deputized Baca just prior to the legendary gun battle.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Mona Lisa, an android who was created to spy and kill, is designed with superior intelligence. But it is that superior intellect which allows her to evolve, leading her to question the morality of her prime directive...and her own existence.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A biogeneticist clones successfully his wife, who is near death in a coma with no expectation of survival. But when his real wife suddenly awakens from her coma, he finds life with not one, but two wives may be quite complicated.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An unemployed man wanders into a curio shop owned by a shape-shifting alien and is offered a rather unique wallet...one that fills with the money of anyone the man comes in physical contact with. However, if it's too good to be true, it often is.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.desc: When an alien seed travels through space and lands on Earth in a rooftop garden, the exotic "flower" it spawns turns out to be an alluring woman who consumes the life and energy out of human victims in the attempt to perpetuate her species on Earth.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After a botched military experiment some four years earlier resulted in the death of one of the test subjects, a doctor now believes the deceased test subject's vengeful spirit is able to jump from one body to another…and is after her.

Now, Brenda says Chris is homeless, living in the woods and has been arrested twice, and she blames Tabatha. Chris says he and Tabatha are “like Romeo and Juliet” and insists nothing, including his “controlling” mother, will break them apart. Emotions run high when these future in-laws face each other on Dr. Phil’s stage. Tabatha and Chris say they are working hard to get on their feet again, and Brenda needs to butt out. Does Brenda have reason for concern? Has the couple remained sober? Plus, Brenda says she is worried Chris and Tabatha are trying to get pregnant -- are they capable of caring for a child? Bill and Bri say not only do they come from two different worlds, but they have a 39-year age gap and are at different stages of their lives – Bri wants a family and children, and Bill has been divorced twice. Bill’s first ex- wife claims Bill has a history of cheating, as she says he cheated on her and has warned Bri it could happen to her. While Bill and Bri have been together for four years, they say they are at a crossroads: what happens when he turns 70 and she is only 31? Also, they say their families don’t see eye-to-eye, which impacts their daily lives. How “healthy” is their relationship? The couple takes Dr. Phil’s “Relationship Health Profile Test” and learns the results. Plus, Dr. Phil speaks with superfans from across the U.S. and has a special announcement for them. The single dad proudly proclaims that being a committed father makes him “one in a million” -- but is John really in over his head? John admits the boys disrespect his authority and recently, he says Alexander punched him in the face and gave him a black eye. Laurie says her children tell her that they aren’t happy living with their father, and she denies deserting her children -- but is she willing to step up and take Dr. Phil’s advice? Then, hear from the three boys. What do they reveal about their home life? And, is this a case of clueless parenting -- or unruly kids? No parent can afford to miss this all-new Dr. Phil!

Suzanne says when the family's home caught fire, Jennifer saved her daughter's friend's baby and left her own children to fend for themselves. Jennifer's 16-year-old daughter, Alyssa, suffered a broken ankle after jumping from the second story, and her 12-year-old son ran back into the burning house to save his 9-year-old sister. Jennifer maintains she is a good mom, and says there was too much smoke and fire to go back for her kids. Was there more she could have done? Is there truth behind Suzanne's accusations? Then, hear Alyssa's emotional plea to Jennifer. Will it make an impact? Don't miss this compelling, all-new Dr. Phil.

programme.desc: The crash of Roswell wasn't meant for New Mexico. In 1947, a neighboring state had 3 major sightings that were swept under the rug. programme.desc: Pressure mounts against the school board to take accountability; Dr. Kenney leaves North Port for what seems like the final time; the community grapples with guilt and grief; Stephen offers an intimate look into Kenney's hypnosis practice.

programme.title: True Crime Story: It Couldn't Happen Here
programme.desc: When a young woman from a wealthy family is found dead in a river, suspicion falls on her well-connected husband; a district attorney's shady misdeeds forever alter the course of the investigation.

programme.title: Gimme the Loot
programme.desc: Big Poppa and Ms. Wallace own and operate their own gentleman’s club, “Gimme the Loot” that’s funded by their criminal earnings. Their revenue is partly earned by their exotic dancers they recruit, who double as their crew to execute heists and bank robberies. But when the new crew finds themselves entangled in a high-stakes world of loyalty, secrets, and danger, their loyalties will be tested, and the crew have to decide if “The Loot” is really worth it.

programme.title: Twisted Marriage
programme.desc: Dexter and Ashley are a married couple, who are close friends with Mary and Paul. On a whim, they decide to swing spouses for the weekend, which leads to questions about their feelings and if their marriages will survive.

programme.title: The Wrong Man
programme.desc: In the wake of a devastating loss, a widowed mother is left to navigate the complexities of life with her two children. She is determined to provide stability and find love again. New love is sometimes not what it seems.

programme.title: She's Watching
programme.desc: Richard and Zoey have recently moved into their dream home, only to find themselves being watched by an obsessed neighbor. Watching them every night isn't enough to satisfy her urges, so she makes an offer they can't refuse.

programme.title: My Man
programme.desc: Trina, a young model, becomes entangled with the charming Max. As their relationship deepens, she uncovers his dark secrets: a double life, a psychotic ex-girlfriend, and a dangerous obsession. When Trina crosses a line, she becomes the target of a deadly game of cat and mouse. Betrayal, madness, and murder ensue as the lines between love, obsession, and survival blur.

programme.title: The Queens Ball
programme.desc: Racine Robinson is the queen pin of a criminal empire, alongside her daughters Cand and Kat. Racine is celebrating her 50th birthday and invited all the regional crime families to come and celebrate. Unbeknownst to her, a contract has been taking out to kil Racine on her birthday. With government intervention, and various talking heads, the death of Racine could lead to open warfare in the city.

programme.title: Rhythm and Revenge
programme.desc: After losing her parents, Journi, a talented but troubled teenager, moves in with her aunt and cousin for a fresh start. As she navigates the pressures of competitive dance, strange accidents begin to occur around her. Suspicion grows, but Journi always seems one step ahead, charming her way out of trouble. However, when the truth starts to unravel, danger lurks closer than anyone could have imagined.

programme.title: How Did We Get Here
programme.desc: Four struggling couples attend a wellness retreat led by Dr. Sellers. Melonie and Derrick struggle with issues of infidelity, Omar and Sonya struggle with commitment, Chastity and Monae have differing opinions on parenthood, and Stephanie and Delvin are struggling with their intimacy. As the couples dive into their treatment, they must confront their own demons to move forward. Will they make it out together? Or go their separate ways?

programme.title: Game of Cards
programme.desc: When data analyst Nicole Tucker’s car is broken into and a mysterious military-issued card tied to her family legacy is stolen, she’s thrust into a dangerous game of betrayal. Her search for the truth uncovers a chilling connection between the theft and her boyfriend Michael, forcing Nicole to confront dark secrets, deadly allies, and a past that refuses to stay buried.

programme.title: The New Girl
programme.desc: When her sister Monica suddenly disappears under suspicious circumstances, Malorie becomes convinced that Monica’s seemingly perfect husband is hiding something sinister. She then launches her own investigation and unearths a twisted web of lies, abuse, and even political conspiracy. Malorie must confront dangerous secrets that not only threaten her sister’s life but her own.

programme.title: Unintended Consequences
programme.desc: A self-absorbed and ill-equipped father struggles to reconnect with his estranged and embittered son following his discovery of his affair with another woman. Wanting to defend his mother’s honor, his son decides to seek revenge on the mistress.

programme.title: Buried
programme.desc: After the murder of his fiancée and her lover, Cameron escapes Atlanta under a new identity and loses the trail of the investigators. When he meets Lauren after settling in Florida, his cover begins to crack when a neighbor begins asking questions, and opening secrets that are supposed to be buried.

When the remains of an apartheid-era policeman are discovered 60 years after he went missing, a retired singer revisits her past to help with the investigation. But how much does she know, and what is she holding back?

programme.title: Repay it in Blood
programme.desc: Ten years after a robbery left their sister dead and their father broken, prosecutor Larissa and her sister Maritza, a top trauma nurse, are done waiting for justice. But just as the sisters begin targeting the crew responsible for that bloody night, the truth becomes deadlier than they anticipated.

programme.title: Flew'd Out
programme.desc: Tiara is an up and coming social media influencer after going viral for posting a mans reaction online after denying him sex. In an attempt to grow her online profile, she accepts a date from a man named Josiah for an out of town excursion. Over time, Josiah's intentions become more elaborate, deranged, and sinister. Will Tiara make it out alive?

programme.title: The Biblical Plagues
programme.desc: Although nine disastrous plagues had already devastated the land along the Nile, Pharaoh remained stubborn and would not release Moses and his people from slavery. And so their God, Yahweh, planned his final assault: At midnight, he sent death over Egypt – all the firstborn, Man or beats, had to die … there was no escape.

programme.title: Monsters and Myths
programme.desc: Monsters have always been part of our nightmares and fairy tales. But where do they actually come from? How much of them is truth, how much is myth? Going to great lengths in this documentary, the filmmakers join scientists to explore a number of the best known sagas and legends in the world.

programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues
programme.desc: “... all the waters that were in the river [Nile] were turned to blood. And all the fish that was in the river died,” reports the Bible, “and the river stank, and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river.” (Exodus 7:20–21).

programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues
programme.desc: “… so there were lice upon man, and upon beast,” reports the Bible, “all the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.” (Exodus 8:18, 17). Even today, two million people die every year from malaria transmitted by mosquitoes, mainly in Africa.

programme.title: Wild Dolphins
programme.desc: In the waters surrounding New Zealand live a number of dolphin species - each of which has evolved unique strategies in their family pods to survive and thrive in the different habitats around these islands in the Pacific Ocean. On the east coast of the south island off the iconic Kaikoura peninsula, an underwater canyon pushes water seething with nutrients to the surface which provides a year round banquet for huge pods of dusky dolphins. These athletic and highly social dolphins spend their nights feeding out in the canyon, and in early morning they return closer to shore where they rest socialize and play. One of their favourite activities is the “seaweed game” where individuals pass pieces of seaweed to each other practicing fancy maneuvers where they’ll catch it on their tail, dorsal or pectoral fins. Down in the south west corner of New Zealand in the majestic landscape of Fiordland live the southern-most bottlenose dolphins. At almost 4 metres long these dolphins have adapted physically to the extreme winter conditions down here by growing bigger and fatter with extra insulating blubber and evolving stubbier beaks and shorter fins and tail flukes to reduce heat loss through their extremities. These fiords are different to the coastal environment in that freshwater sits on top of the denser seawater in a distinct layer, and is much colder than the saltwater and can prove lethal to the pods’ calves in winter, so every year the bottlenose dolphins make a short migration to the outer fiords where there is less freshwater to enable their calves to survive. Off New Zealand’s north island, in the middle of the Bay of Plenty, the country’s most active volcano erupts from the sea, sending plumes of toxic gases rising skywards. In the water surrounding this volcano roam common dolphins - the nomads of the dolphin world. They are pelagic predators which mean they roam the open ocean searching for prey.

programme.title: Eagle Queen of the Skies
programme.desc: Eagles are top predators who battle fiercely for survival and work hard to raise their young. There are 60 members of the eagle clan, all united by their acute eyesight, powerful wings, sharp talons and hooked beaks. To explore the world of the eagle we follow one individual from hatching to leaving the nest and setting up a home. Her fight for survival reveals what it takes to become a queen of the sky.

programme.title: Eagle Lakes
programme.desc: The Lauenburg Lake District is located between Lübeck and Lauenburg on the River Elbe. With more than 470 square kilometres, it is the third largest natural reserve in Schleswig-Holstein. Due to its extensive forest areas, 40 lakes and its proximity to Mecklenburg’s biosphere reserve Lake Schalsee, it forms the largest protectoral area alongside the former inner-German border.

programme.title: Anaconda Wanted
programme.desc: Anacondas have fired people's imagination since time immemorial. Hardly any other animal is so feared and yet at the same time so revered as the biggest snake in the world.

programme.title: Sudden Death
programme.desc: The gallery forests of the Serengeti are the realm of a phantom. The shadowy thickets are the domain of a Leopardess.

programme.title: Haunted Huntress
programme.desc: A brook in the Serengeti is the home of a leopardess. The secret queen of the shadows took care of her son and has done a good job so far but the adventure continues.

programme.title: Animals That Changed History - Season 1
programme.desc: Human life today would be very different if our ancestors had not stopped hunting animal protein. In the Fertile Crescent - known today as the Middle East - humans travelled in nomadic groups of hunter-gatherers and ate what they killed.

programme.title: Animals That Changed History - Season 1
programme.desc: When our ancestors saw how other animals kept warm in sub-freezing temperatures, they started hunting them for their hides and fur. As hominid evolution was diverging from other primates, they lost their thick covering of fur when the mercury dropped.

programme.title: Animals That Changed History - Season 1
programme.desc: About twelve thousand years ago, before the Neolithic Revolution, humans were mainly hunter-gatherers. Among the animals we hunted were the wild aurochs, the ancestor of all domestic cattle. The domestication of cows led to the use of oxen as draught animals that could help farmers plough fields.

programme.title: Animals That Changed History - Season 1
programme.desc: Throughout history, humans have surrounded themselves with animals. But there are two species that are our undeniable favourites. Every dog today was once a wolf - genetically speaking. Wolves and hominids met as early as 400,000 years ago. Ancient hunter-gatherers and wolves competed for the same prey, and used the same tracking techniques.

programme.title: Big is beautiful
programme.desc: The world is full of giants, huge creatures that fill us with awe and wonder. Some are gentle giants. Others are deadly hunters. There are different ways of defining ‘big’ - biggest in volume, or the biggest of their kind. But one thing is for sure, the huge animals of this world are fascinating, diverse and beautiful.

programme.title: Sharks of the Icy North
programme.desc: We mostly know the nimble predators from the depths of tropical seas. At the same time very little is known about the sharks of the icy North.

programme.title: Animals That Changed History - Season 1
programme.desc: For most of our history, people have fallen victim to crippling disease, and not had a clue where it came from. Despite our best efforts, we are vulnerable - not, perhaps, to lions, tigers, and bears - but more to the killers we can’t even see. In America during the early 1980s, a mysterious new disease claims the lives of 159 people, most of them gay men.

programme.title: Animals That Changed History - Season 1
programme.desc: As a species, we believe we are more than just animals. We are inspired to express ourselves through words, art, music, and scientific endeavours. Our ancestors painted animals on cave walls - usually large mammals, like bison and deer. Animals were out first artistic subject, our first inspiration.

programme.title: The Story of Europe
programme.desc: Europe's history has many dark sides, but its culture is more than a small gleam of hope, it radiates in many areas far out into the world. The old continent sets standards in art, literature and science. Starting with the ancient Greeks, Europe produces a number of smart and creative minds: from Aristotle to Michelangelo and Einstein, from Beethoven to the Beatles.

programme.title: The Story of Europe
programme.desc: Europe has been a battle concept for centuries: it often takes foreign enemies to weld the Europeans together. But for centuries, they are primarily fighting against themselves. It was not until the Enlightenment and the French Revolution of 1789 that a new idea of Europe emerged based on common values: freedom, equality and fraternalism.

programme.title: The Story of Europe
programme.desc: Europe has never experienced such a long period of peace and prosperity as after the Second World War. When the Iron Curtain falls in 1989, the dream of a Europe united in peace and freedom seems finally to become reality. But whether financial or refugee crisis - the European euphoria has disappeared, nationalists are on the rise again.

programme.title: Wild Sex
programme.desc: Sex is at the heart of everything. It’s the only real way of leaving a legacy - in the genes of the future. But there’s more than just the act - it’s the build up to it when wildlife shows its incredible diversity. It drives touching courtships and fierce battles. Hormones and sex drive are forces that shape behaviour and can change an animal’s purpose and persona. This is the story of how wild things get sexy.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show Season 7 episode 10
programme.desc: It’s the final, and the tent plays host to three Royal challenges to impress the Queen. The signature challenge sees a return to meringues. For the technical challenge, the bakers have only one recipe instruction. Then the bakers' face their last show-stopper. Who will be crowned champion?

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show:An Extra Slice
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show: An Extra Slice Season 3 Episode 1
programme.desc: Each week, host Jo Brand chats to a panel of celebrity fans, looking at all the shenanigans in the tent. Jo shines a spotlight on the best, the worst and the 'must try harder next time' bakes from the latest episode, with chat and an interview with the baker who left the tent that week.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show:An Extra Slice
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show: An Extra Slice Season 3 Episode 2
programme.desc: This week, Jo Brand is joined by comedian Josh Widdicombe and chef Rosemary Shrager to dissect the latest goings-on, with unseen footage and an interview with the latest baker to leave the tent. Jo and her guests celebrate biscuit week by tasting audience attempts at gingerbread and garibaldis.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show:An Extra Slice
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show: An Extra Slice Season 3 Episode 3
programme.desc: Host Jo Brand is joined by three celebrity fans who give their take on the remaining ten bakers and their bakes. Jo and her guests also cast their eyes over the baked bread brought in by the studio audience and look at viewer photos of their bakes from home, be they triumphs or heroic fails.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show:An Extra Slice
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show:Baking Show: An Extra Slice Season 3 Episode 4
programme.desc: Joining host Jo Brand in the An Extra Slice studio are former shadow chancellor Ed Balls, chef Monica Galetti and comedian Henning Wehn. As well as dissecting this week's goings on in the tent, Jo interviews the latest baker to leave, reveals more exclusive footage and tastes the audience home bakes

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show:An Extra Slice
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show: An Extra Slice Season 3 Episode 5
programme.desc: Host Jo Brand is joined by three celebrity guests, including renowned chef Michel Roux Jr, giving their take on this week's shenanigans. Along with chat and unseen footage, Jo interviews the latest baker to leave the tent and tastes the audience bakes – the good and the bad!

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show:An Extra Slice
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show: An Extra Slice Season 3 Episode 6
programme.desc: Joining host Jo Brand in the studio are three celebrity fans including Danny Baker, all eager to chew over the latest goings on in the tent. There is unseen footage, chat about the latest baking shenanigans and an interview with the latest baker to leave.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show:An Extra Slice
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show: An Extra Slice Season 3 Episode 7

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show:An Extra Slice
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show: An Extra Slice Season 3 Episode 8

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show:An Extra Slice
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show: An Extra Slice Season 3 Episode 9

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show:An Extra Slice
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show:An Extra Slice Season 3 Episode 10

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.sub-title: The Great British Wedding Cake Season 1
programme.desc: Renowned baking writer Mary Berry and professional baker Paul Hollywood explore the history of the Great British wedding cake, looking at its change from the earliest Tudor creation and the extravagant Victorian period to wartime Britain, the affluent eighties and present day

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show Masterclass Season 2
programme.desc: The ultimate baking masterclass with judges Mary Berry and Paul Hollywood. Featuring how to bake Mary's take on a traditional British cake - a coffee and walnut Battenberg, her classic tarte au citron, Paul's traditional Italian flatbread, focaccia and Mary's brandy snaps.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show Masterclass Season 2
programme.desc: The masterclass features Paul's luxury pork pies, filled with the perfect combination of pork loin and a quail's egg, and Mary's chocolate roulade recipe where Mary will show you how to get the perfect roll every time. Plus Paul's traditional iced fingers and Mary's sachertorte.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show Masterclass Season 3
programme.desc: It's the calm after the baking storm, and Paul Hollywood and Mary Berry take over the Bake Off tent to show us how the technical challenges should be done. Taking us through every step of the first five technical recipes of the series, they show us exactly how to avoid the mistakes some of the bakers made

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show Masterclass Season 3
programme.desc: If you've ever wanted to know how to make the technical challenges from The Great British Bake Off, then this is your chance. Mary Berry and Paul Hollywood are back in the Bake Off tent to show us exactly how to tackle the remaining recipes from the series.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show Masterclass Season 3
programme.desc: With the Bake Off tent all to themselves, Mary Berry and Paul Hollywood show us, which Signature Bakes they would have chosen if they were in the bakers shoes. They guide us through every step of their recipes, proving that everybody can give baking a go if you follow their advice.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show Masterclass Season 4
programme.desc: Mary and Paul take over the tent and share all their tips and tricks to get the perfect results at home. They make Mary's whole orange cake and angel food cake, Paul's breakfast muffins and olive bread sticks, and together, their chocolate cake showstopper.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show Masterclass Season 4
programme.desc: Mary and Paul show tips and tricks to ensure the perfect results at home. Mary shares her family recipe for her tipsy trifle, floating islands and wobbly apricot tart, whilst Paul goes through his custard tarts and showstopping spanakopita

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show Masterclass Season 4
programme.desc: Paul Hollywood and Mary Berry show what they would have made in biscuit and pastry weeks, including tuiles with chocolate mousse.

programme.title: The Great Pottery Throw Down
programme.sub-title: The Great British Pottery Throw Down Season 6 Episode 7
programme.desc: The remaining potters discover their wild sides as they create metallic effect, endangered animal sculptures, fired in oil drums. Judges Keith Brymer Jones and Rich Miller set a surprise second challenge to throw a tall, thin necked vase but who will make the quarter-final?

programme.title: The Great Pottery Throw Down
programme.sub-title: The Great Pottery Throw Down Season 6 Episode 8
programme.desc: It’s the quarter-final and the five potters face an altered reality as they throw and radically alter an abstract coffee set. The bucket of doom returns as judges Keith Brymer Jones and Rich Miller set a second challenge to throw multiple high footed rice bowls under pressure,

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show Masterclass Season 4
programme.desc: Paul Hollywood and Mary Berry share what they would have made for the challenges in the final weeks of the Baking Show. Paul makes a wheat-free crusty rye loaf and sweet and savoury pretzels whilst Mary goes through her choux pastry religieuse and creates her own twist on the classic opera cake.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show Masterclass Season 5
programme.desc: Paul makes a blackcurrant and liquorice swirly swiss roll, whilst Mary takes us through her perfect cherry cake with lemon icing. Paul demonstrates how to make two types of savoury biscuits, and Mary shows us how to make florentines, before finishing with miniature classic coffee and walnut cakes

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: In the quarter finals, Belgian Moroccan Anis Bouzid (48-4, 37 KO) takes on kickboxing legend Errol Zimmerman (112-20-1, 45 KO), Serbian sensation Milos Cvjeticanin (17-5, 10 KO) meets number one French heavyweight Sofian Laidouni (42-5-1, 20 KO), monstrous Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (29-4-1, 16 KO) clashes with ‘The Soldier’ Nidal Bchiri (20-5-1, 5 KO), and ‘The Black Ghost’ Mory Kromah (35-3-1, 21 KO) collides with outspoken rival Michael ‘Timebomb’ Boapeah (23-5-1, 29 KO). Only one fighter can come out on top and walk away as the new ‘King of Kickboxing’. Elsewhere, the always exciting Bahram Rajabzadeh (72-6, 64 KO) goes up against ‘The Gladiator’ Cristian Ristea (44-27, 13 KO), Hamicha (42-2, 31 KO) puts his undefeated GLORY record on the line against late replacement Brice Kombou (20-6, 5 KO), and featherweights Andre Santos (23-2, 10 KO) and Deniz Demirkapu (15-5, 10 KO) will kick-off the main card.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: Donovan Wisse (20-1, 10 KO) puts his middleweight championship on the line against number one contender Ulric Bokeme (32-4, 17 KO) in the main event of the evening. Wisse is one of the top P4P kickboxers on the planet today and is chasing his fourth straight title defense. After his Grand Prix heroics, the number one ranked heavyweight Levi Rigters (17-2, 8 KO) returns to action to take on dangerous late notice replacement Nico Pereira Horta (22-8, 3 KO) in the co-main event. The ‘King of The Hague’ crown is up for grabs when rivals Michael Boapeah (16-4-1, 7 KO) and Serkan Ozcaglayan (45-9, 36 KO) clash. The two top middleweights meet in this local derby match-up where the winner walks away with bragging rights in a fight that is sure to split the arena.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: Serkan Ozcaglayan makes his GLORY premiere, a battle of the best Featherweights in the division and Nabiev takes on Troy Jones in the Welterweight division.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: 6 Champions, 3 Title Fights, 1 Special Night. The main event features a four man heavyweight tournament including Glory heavyweight champion Rico Verhoeven, as well as Hesdy Gerges, Levi Rigters and Tarik Khbabez.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: The GLORY welterweight title will be on the line in the main event as the reigning & defending champion Endy Semeleer (35-1, 17 KO) welcomes the challenge of top contender Chico Kwasi (42-5, 22 KO). In the co-main event, after his crazy GLORY Heavyweight Grand Prix performance, the wild & exciting Bahram Rajabzadeh (66-2, 58 KO) steps down to light heavyweight and meets the hard-hitting Paris-based Kevin Oumar (33-4, 7 KO), a French kickboxing champion & budding MMA star. Belgian-Moroccan superstar Youssef Boughanem (187-43-8, 119 KO) steps into the GLORY ring for the very first time in his illustrious career as he meets the Ukraine’s Stanislav Kazantsev (25-8-1, 7 KO). The best of French kickboxing will be on display throughout the rest of the card as a host of the nation’s top stars will be in action against opponents from all over the world.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: 3 wins to come out on top, who's it going to be? Rico Verhoeven, Levi Rigters, Tarik Osaro, Benjamin Adegbuyi, Sofian Laidouni, Uku Jurjendal, Bahram Rajabzadeh, and Nabil Khachab pair up and throw down for the GLORY Heavyweight Grand Prix, an 8-man 1-night heavyweight tournament for the ages.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Justin Hammer
programme.desc: ‪@justinhamnerfishing‬ followed his passion and that dream led him to the Bassmaster Elite Series. After a few years on the Elites, he was in the catbird seat of the 2024 Bassmaster Classic where his lifelong dream came true and he became the World Champion of bass fishing. Watch his week unfold at Grand Lake O' the Cherokees in Oklahoma.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Drew Benton
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance at the 2023 Lake Murray Bassmaster Elite Series, watch Drew Benton's tournament as he notched his 2nd Bassmaster victory. Benton started the week in 2nd place, jumped into the lead, fell to 10th and then completed a comeback of over 5 pounds on the Final Day to win.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Joey Cifuentes
programme.desc: First year Bassmaster Elite Series pro Joey Cifuentes dominated the Lake Seminole Elite event and took his first pro-level victory. Cifuentes outlasted the field with a four-day total of 85 pounds, 2 ounces. In this Marathon Peak Performance you can watch his winning week.

programme.title: Peak Performance -Patrick Walters
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance at the St. Lawrence River, watch as Patrick Walters wins his 2nd Elite Series victory and breaks the 100-pound mark for the 3rd time in his career.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Jay Przekurat
programme.desc: As a 23-year old rookie on the Bassmaster Elite Series, Jay Przekurat made history. In the Marathon Peak Performance at the St. Lawrence River, Przekurat becomes the youngest Elite Series champion and also breaks 100 pounds for the first time in history for a smallmouth bass event. Watch his week unfold in Clayton, NY.

programme.title: Peak Performance - LukePalmer
programme.desc: Bassmaster Elite Series pro Luke Palmer has been dubbed as one of the most consistent pros early in his career. His first four years all found him in the 20’s for Angler of the Year and while he’s shown signs of his ability, wins have eluded him. At Santee Cooper he has his Marathon Peak Performance as he follows up a 4th last year, with a win in South Carolina in 2023.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Tyler Rivet
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance from Lake Okeechobee, follow Tyler Rivet as he closes in on his first Bassmaster Elite Series title. Rivet is a 5th year Elite Series pro who started his career in college at Nicholls State where he formed a Bass Team and fished in every Bassmaster National Championship during his five years in school.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Austin Felix
programme.desc: Austin Felix had an impeccable smallmouth record in Bassmaster Elite Series events prior to Lake Oahe, but the Minnesota pro went to another level after four successful days in South Dakota. In the Marathon Peak Performance at Lake Oahe, watch Austin Felix take home his first tour-level victory with Bassmaster.

programme.title: Peak Performance - John Garrett
programme.desc: The Marathon Peak Performance for the third stop of the Elite Series season features John Garrett and his impressive week at the Harris Chain of Lakes. The former College Champion and current Elite Series rookie led wire to wire and got his first blue trophy in just his 3rd event of the season.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Ed Loughran III
programme.desc: Ed Loughran, who is also a practicing attorney, notched his biggest fishing achievement by winning the Bassmaster Elite Series event at Lake Champlain. He leaned on both largemouth and smallmouth en route to his first career victory. He is the Marathon Peak Performance for the 8th event of the 2024 Elite Series season.

programme.title: Best of Morning Footy
programme.desc: CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is a first-of-its-kind free, 24-hour channel in the U.S.dedicated exclusively to global soccer coverage. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK, with its unparalleled coverage of all the top domestic and international soccer competitions across the globe, is the ultimate year-round streaming destination for soccer fans. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is anchored weekdays from 7:00-9:00 AM, ET, by - MORNING FOOTY, the Network’s flagship morning show. Every weekday, MORNING FOOTY host Susannah Collins along with former U.S. Men’s National Team player Charlie Davies, analyst Nico Cantor and comedian Alexis Guerreros bring their unique voices and fresh perspectives to the latest news and storylines impacting soccer worldwide. As soccer’s new staple show for fans everywhere, MORNING FOOTY delivers a daily dose of razor-sharp insights and laughs with match highlights, compelling analysis, entertaining interviews, updates - from reporter Jenny Chiu and more that is sure to help kick off your day. In addition, the Network will feature live matches, pre- and post-match breakdowns, magazine shows, films from Paramount+’s STORIES FROM THE BEAUTIFUL GAME soccer documentary collection and original programming. The Network’s live matches and re-airs utilize CBS Sports’ collection of top-tier soccer properties, including UEFA club competitions, Serie A, NWSL, Concacaf national team competitions, Barclays Women’s Super League, Campeonato Brasileirão Série A, Scottish Professional Football League, Argentina Liga Profesional de Fútbol and the AFC Champions League, among others. Watch CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK 24 hours a day, 7 days a week and all 365 days a year.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.sub-title: Mercedes 280 SE goes America - New York
programme.desc: Tillmann starts his dream journey in New York, the city that never sleeps. With his Mercedes 280 SE convertible he visits the legendary classic car dealer Eliot Cuker who made his fortune with his passion for old cars.

programme.title: Arden AJ23
programme.desc: A Jaguar that is able to terrify the world alone with its roar. This Jaguar F-Type R tuned by Arden is a real bad boy. Already in the series production configuration, the F-Type R Coupe is a dream car that can really bite but this Jaguar which has been upgraded from Arden, now calls itself "AJ23“ and is more powerful, louder and more aggressive than any of his brothers.

programme.title: Jaguar XJR
programme.desc: The highlight of the XJR lies beneath the hood: all of Jaguar's top models are equipped with the 5-liter V8 compressor engine that delivers 550 HP in this sports sedan.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: Once again it was time for the VLN Endurance Racing Championship. While the drivers were doing their test laps, we had a look behind the scenes and explored what went on in the pit lanes.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: The fourth race of the VLN season is usually regarded as a dress rehearsal for the 24-hour race. For the top teams and best drivers it is the last opportunity for a really thorough test.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: We present the highlights of last week. The 24 hour race was exciting, as usual. In addition, we explored the 'Strong Man Run' and took a look at the tourist drivers

programme.title: BMW 503
programme.desc: The noble four-seater 503 convertible was one of BMWs most exclusive models in the 1950s. Many international sports and movie stars and other wealthy customers were fond of this sporty luxury vehicle.

programme.title: Volvo S90
programme.desc: It looks sportier than one might expect from the Swedes. The taillights frame the powerful looking rear. On the inside, the Volvo S90 impresses with the finest materials and soft nappa leather.

programme.title: Alfa Romeo 6C 2500SS
programme.desc: Founded in 1910, the iconic Italian car manufacturer Alfa Romeo experienced a very eventful history. Their 6C 2500 SS model is right in the middle of the company's more than 100-year history. It combined new technology with an early post-war appearance.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: We took the Mercedes AMG SLS GT to an airfield and the Porsche 911 Turbo S to the racetrack in order to see these sporty driving machines in action and test their performance. In addition: the Audi R8 4.0 TFSI's innovative lighting technology.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Jaguar found their way back to the world of sports cars. The F-Type doesn't just look good, it's got what it takes, and the car is able to take on the competition like the BMW Z4. We also took a closer look at two other competitors, the Porsche Boxster S and Nissan's 370 Z.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: For more than 60 years the Corvette has been the embodiment of the American sports car. Also: the Ford Mustang GT, an iconic model with a V8 engine at the price of a Volkswagen Passat. And: the Chevrolet Camaro, another classic from the land where cylinder capacity is still valued a lot.

programme.title: Lamborghini Huracan by O.CT
programme.desc: A lot of power thanks to a compressor. This optimized O.CT Lamborghini Huracán delivers over 800 horse power to get the blood flowing.

programme.title: Morgan ARP4
programme.desc: Since 1950, the exhilarating Morgan +4 has been the mainstay of Morgan production. The ARP4 is the latest addition to the +4 family and strictly limited to a run of 50.

programme.title: Beradino
programme.desc: A „bella macchina“, a beautiful car - but not designed by masters like Bertone or Pininfarina. Johannes Paulussen from Neuss in Germany built the Beradino by hand.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The emphatically sporty cars and motorbikes of BMW are equally successful with customers and in racing. However, the former aircraft engine manufacturer's entry into automobile production threatened to fail at an early stage.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The Porsche 550 Spyder is small and fast, but only 140 units were built. It was Porsche's first racing sports car and laid the foundation for the German manufacturer to be considered a force in car racing today.

programme.title: Baselines
programme.desc: Set in Los Angeles, this series follows Jamiel Chambers, a blue chip high-schooler on the brink of escaping the desperate poverty that has berated inner city America. After his junior year ends with him leading his team to a second place finish in the state's regional tournament, Jamiel is hand-picked to play in the city's annual summer league All-Star game. With college recruits swarming and pro agents hedging, the media circus leans in, peddling the question mark around his future like rabid bookies. It is this exposure that gets the attention of Nick Collins, a derelict from a disreputable family from neighboring Irvine. After his doomed-from-the-start plan to capitalize on Jamiel's notoriety ends in with fatal results, family members from both sides are pulled into a series of events which will not only effect Jamiel's trajectory, but will set up one of the most intense family feuds the city has ever witnessed.

programme.title: One Perfect Day in Kentucky
programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF’s Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: Hayman's Way
programme.desc: Follow David Hayman as he unearths the people and places that make Scotland unique.

programme.title: The World Is Yours
programme.desc: Our journey begins where much of our history began. We will visit the Parthenon in Athens, Greece. Considered one of the most important monuments of the millenarian western civilization. There we will see very closely the Panathenaic Stadium, where the first Olympic Games were held. Then we will travel from one of the oldest cities in the world to a beacon of urban modernity; Berlin, a city that sets the pace and is rich in culture. We will meet some of the protagonists of contemporary German history and taste part of its popular cuisine. To end our trip, we will go to the place where the German and Greek influences converge: We will land on the Mediterranean island of Sicily, where a particularly active volcano awaits our arrival and for lovers of extreme sports we will practice Kitesurfing.

Then we will travel from one of the oldest cities in the world to a beacon of urban modernity; Berlin, a city that sets the pace and is rich in culture. We will meet some of the protagonists of contemporary German history and taste part of its popular cuisine. To end our trip, we will go to the place where the German and Greek influences converge: We will land on the Mediterranean island of Sicily, where a particularly active volcano awaits our arrival and for lovers of extreme sports we will practice Kitesurfing.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 63: Celos, Descubrimientos y Gran Impacto
programme.desc: Gabriel se deja invadir por los celos acrecentando aun mas su desconfianza en contra de Marisela al ver a esta en compañía de Reynaldo. El padre Venancio ayuda a Jesús a reincorporarse en su silla de ruedas al este informarlo sobre su gran error tras haber alertado a Ricardo de la gran fortuna que le fue despojada a su esposa tras ser heredera del difunto Ricardo. Alfonso descubre en Brillante un alma similar en gustos y perversidad al recibir de ella un estrafalario obsequio. Al estar acompañada por sus compañeros de universidad, Gabriela se ve victima de un gran impacto al ser informada por Giancarlos y sus amigos de la verdadera condición social y económica de su novio Ricardo.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 106: La verdad sale a la luz
programme.desc: A Luis Fernando se le pierde algo en la oficina, le pregunta a todo el mundo si han visto el pen drive que perdió, le pregunta a Dileidi pero como ella esta algo sentida por lo que le paso a su hermano se pone de inmediato a la defensiva, el se disculpa, le dice que el no sabía que Gerson era su hermano, que de haberlo sabido lo hubiese arreglado de otra manera, ella también esta apenada pues sabe el prontuario de su hermano y ahora los dos piensan que ya para ellos después de ese problema seguro que no tendrán mas oportunidad de estar juntos. La mayoría celebra que Gerson este preso, entre esas están la Felicita y Maria Gracia, Cristina por su parte lo defiende de todo el mundo, cuando Tatiana escucha aclara que no pudo haber sido el quien robo el carro de Luis Fernando pues el estaba la noche anterior en la fiesta de su papá y en compañía de Doroteo, a Felicita le molesta que Tatiana haya dicho que eso, tiene que decir solo cosas que perjudiquen al muchacho, en ese momento llega del colegio Alegría y se entera que el hijo de Gladis esta preso por su culpa. Todos hacen leña del árbol caído, por su parte Pascuita despedirá a Gladis, no puede aceptar que una persona con un hijo malandro trabaje en su casa, Matilde habla en defensa de Gladis, le recuerda que es una mujer de confianza, que toda la vida a ha trabajado para todas ellas, Pascuita recuerda el incidente cuando se perdió el vestido de Cristina, Matilde insiste en defender a Gladis, Ramón también esta de acuerdo con que Gladis no es culpable de nada, Gonzalo por su parte apoya lo dicho por Pascuita ya van a empezar pascuita y Matilde a dispararse indirectas cuando los hijos de ambas interrumpen la guerra que digo la discusión y les dicen a sus padres que fueron ellos quienes se robaron el carro y quienes lo chocaron, todos quedan en shock. Gabito le da a poyo a Gladis, le dice que de esa también saldrán ella le agradece su posición tan incondicional para con ella, en eso llega Remedios, y después de preguntarle a Gladis por su hijo le hace cariños a Gabito delante de Gladis, le dice que le preparo un mondongo y Gladis se siente mal, se pone celosa, a Gabito le huele a quemado y remedios tiene que retirarse, empiezan a pelear en voz baja, Gladis le dice que el esta bien con Remedios, el le recuerda que el a quien quiere de verdad es a ella, pero que ella tiene miedo, en cambio Remedios lo quiere, lo cuida, lo respeta y eso es lo que el quiere, ella le dice que un pajarito le dijo que Remedios lo quería pero para cambiarlo. La Nena quiere hablar con Theo, quiere aclararle que ella no tuvo nada que ver con esa fiesta, pero el cuando ve que es ella quien lo llama no responde, esta con Rosa y le pide que apure lo del divorcio, que quizás si eso no hubiera pasado el le contesta el teléfono, pero que ya se canso de que se burlen de el, Rosa trata por todos los medios de que Theo cambie de opinión pero el esta muy decidido. La que se alegra de que Theo no responda el teléfono es Tatiana, quien le recuerda a su mamá que lo mejor es lo que pasa y que si ya paso eso entre ellos que se resigne, la Nena le recuerda que ella lo único que quiere es lavar su imagen pues no quiere que ni Theo ni nadie piensen que ella tuvo algo que ver con ese espectáculo tan bochornoso. Santiago invita a Egleé para el cine, ella dice que solos no por que no estaría bien, entonces Santiago invita a todo el personal de la oficina y el paga la entrada pero eso si el escoge la película, Luis Fernando le reclama que este organizando salidas pues se la esta poniendo fácil a Aureliano, mientras que el ya perdió todas las oportunidades con Dileidi. Llega Luis Fernando a su casa y lo esperan los que le robaron el carro con sus respectivas madres, Luis Fernando no entiende nada al principio, su hermana bromea, luego los muchachos le dicen que fueron ellos quienes robaron su carro y de paso lo chocaron, Luis Fernando se siente peor, ahora si ya no hay dudas el hermano de Dileidi es inocente de todo los cargos que el hizo, se siente mal, pide que lo dejen solo, luego se va a la comisaría y reconoce que hizo algo que no debía, declara que Gerson no fue quien robo su carro, firma unos documentos y espera a que salga Gerson, quien se burla de el, le acepta la disculpa pero le recuerda que su mamá y su hermana no lo perdonarán tan fácilmente, pues a las López no se les olvida un agravio. Aureliano invita a Dileidi a salir, esta al principio se niega pero su amiga Yenilu la convence de que vaya y así lo hace. Betzaida entra en cólera cuando se entera que Rómulo le echo el cuento primero a Egleé que a ella que es su esposa, siempre es Egleé la que tiene preferencia en la vida de Rómulo. Pascuita y Ramón regañan a su hija, luego discuten ellos pues Ramón pretende que su mujer se disculpe con Matilde por haberle dicho mala madre, cosa que por supuesto pascuita no esta dispuesta hacer, por su parte Matilde también regaña a su hijo, luego se forma una pelea igual con Gonzalo, lo único que Matilde le pide a su hijo es que no le cuente nada delante de la bruja de pascuita. Gladis esta contenta por que ya su hijo esta libre y eso demuestra que esta vez el no tuvo nada que ver con eso, Egleé esta preocupada por lo que le pueda pasar al hijo de Gladis y peor aún por que si ella se queda sin Gladis es el acabose, Marco Aurelio llama a Gladis y se pone a la orden para cualquier cosa que necesite, ella le dice que ya su hijo esta libre, Marco Aurelio aprovecha para coquetear con Gladis a ella le gusta.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 51: Marisela suena con Armando Malave
programme.desc: Inés le declara a Luis Guillermo su amor, pero cuando él se ilusiona le hace saber que después de lo que le dijo la noche antes, ese amor murió para siempre. Diego Andrés le dice a Marisela que se divorciará de Michelle y luego se casará con ella y Marisela se marcha muy alegre pero después decide que eso nunca será posible porque él es un doctor y ella muy poca cosa. Michelle le exige a Flavia que se divorcie de su padre porque él no la quiere y tiene una amante. Berta está furiosa con Armando por haberla dejado sola pero se ilusiona pensando que cuando sea su esposa las cosas cambiarán porque ella impondrá sus condiciones. Marisela sueña y en su sueño ve a Armando Malavé como su padre y se despierta desesperada y no puede creer que eso sea verdad.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Alejandro se entera de que Abril sabe la razón por la cual Inmaculada lo dejó plantado en el altar pero no le quiere decir y le responde que le pregunta el motivo a Inmaculada. Alejandro también se da cuenta de que su padre, Ángel sabe algo pero este tampoco le quiere contar nada. El peludo le regala un auto a Pelusa y le dice que como el corre riesgo de muerte quiere dejar toda su fortuna a nombre de ella. Pelusa ve a Josué trabajando en una obra en construcción pero luego se aleja y se va en su camioneta nueva sin hablar con él.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 63: El plan de Don Carlos
programme.desc: Socorro evade a Josefina diciéndole que pronto le presentará al hombre con quien está, así que Josefina se retira de la habitación, pero en seguida intenta sobornar a Helena para que le diga el nombre del novio de Cocó, sin embargo Helena no cede ante el dinero. Socorro le insiste a Salvador que le digan a Josefina sobre su relación, pues ella y su padre son de origen humilde y está segura que los apoyarán, pero Salvador no está de acuerdo, él está convencido que Josefina los va a separar.Don Carlos les ordena a sus escoltas que arroyen a Salvador, pero lejos de la presencia de María para que ella no sufra.

Todos hacen leña del árbol caído, por su parte Pascuita despedirá a Gladis, no puede aceptar que una persona con un hijo malandro trabaje en su casa, Matilde habla en defensa de Gladis, le recuerda que es una mujer de confianza, que toda la vida a ha trabajado para todas ellas, Pascuita recuerda el incidente cuando se perdió el vestido de Cristina, Matilde insiste en defender a Gladis, Ramón también esta de acuerdo con que Gladis no es culpable de nada, Gonzalo por su parte apoya lo dicho por Pascuita ya van a empezar pascuita y Matilde a dispararse indirectas cuando los hijos de ambas interrumpen la guerra que digo la discusión y les dicen a sus padres que fueron ellos quienes se robaron el carro y quienes lo chocaron, todos quedan en shock. Gabito le da a poyo a Gladis, le dice que de esa también saldrán ella le agradece su posición tan incondicional para con ella, en eso llega Remedios, y después de preguntarle a Gladis por su hijo le hace cariños a Gabito delante de Gladis, le dice que le preparo un mondongo y Gladis se siente mal, se pone celosa, a Gabito le huele a quemado y remedios tiene que retirarse, empiezan a pelear en voz baja, Gladis le dice que el esta bien con Remedios, el le recuerda que el a quien quiere de verdad es a ella, pero que ella tiene miedo, en cambio Remedios lo quiere, lo cuida, lo respeta y eso es lo que el quiere, ella le dice que un pajarito le dijo que Remedios lo quería pero para cambiarlo. La Nena quiere hablar con Theo, quiere aclararle que ella no tuvo nada que ver con esa fiesta, pero el cuando ve que es ella quien lo llama no responde, esta con Rosa y le pide que apure lo del divorcio, que quizás si eso no hubiera pasado el le contesta el teléfono, pero que ya se canso de que se burlen de el, Rosa trata por todos los medios de que Theo cambie de opinión pero el esta muy decidido. La que se alegra de que Theo no responda el teléfono es Tatiana, quien le recuerda a su mamá que lo mejor es lo que pasa y que si ya paso eso entre ellos que se resigne, la Nena le recuerda que ella lo único que quiere es lavar su imagen pues no quiere que ni Theo ni nadie piensen que ella tuvo algo que ver con ese espectáculo tan bochornoso. Santiago invita a Egleé para el cine, ella dice que solos no por que no estaría bien, entonces Santiago invita a todo el personal de la oficina y el paga la entrada pero eso si el escoge la película, Luis Fernando le reclama que este organizando salidas pues se la esta poniendo fácil a Aureliano, mientras que el ya perdió todas las oportunidades con Dileidi. Llega Luis Fernando a su casa y lo esperan los que le robaron el carro con sus respectivas madres, Luis Fernando no entiende nada al principio, su hermana bromea, luego los muchachos le dicen que fueron ellos quienes robaron su carro y de paso lo chocaron, Luis Fernando se siente peor, ahora si ya no hay dudas el hermano de Dileidi es inocente de todo los cargos que el hizo, se siente mal, pide que lo dejen solo, luego se va a la comisaría y reconoce que hizo algo que no debía, declara que Gerson no fue quien robo su carro, firma unos documentos y espera a que salga Gerson, quien se burla de el, le acepta la disculpa pero le recuerda que su mamá y su hermana no lo perdonarán tan fácilmente, pues a las López no se les olvida un agravio. Aureliano invita a Dileidi a salir, esta al principio se niega pero su amiga Yenilu la convence de que vaya y así lo hace. Betzaida entra en cólera cuando se entera que Rómulo le echo el cuento primero a Egleé que a ella que es su esposa, siempre es Egleé la que tiene preferencia en la vida de Rómulo. Pascuita y Ramón regañan a su hija, luego discuten ellos pues Ramón pretende que su mujer se disculpe con Matilde por haberle dicho mala madre, cosa que por supuesto pascuita no esta dispuesta hacer, por su parte Matilde también regaña a su hijo, luego se forma una pelea igual con Gonzalo, lo único que Matilde le pide a su hijo es que no le cuente nada delante de la bruja de pascuita. Gladis esta contenta por que ya su hijo esta libre y eso demuestra que esta vez el no tuvo nada que ver con eso, Egleé esta preocupada por lo que le pueda pasar al hijo de Gladis y peor aún por que si ella se queda sin Gladis es el acabose, Marco Aurelio llama a Gladis y se pone a la orden para cualquier cosa que necesite, ella le dice que ya su hijo esta libre, Marco Aurelio aprovecha para coquetear con Gladis a ella le gusta.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 51: Marisela suena con Armando Malave
programme.desc: Inés le declara a Luis Guillermo su amor, pero cuando él se ilusiona le hace saber que después de lo que le dijo la noche antes, ese amor murió para siempre. Diego Andrés le dice a Marisela que se divorciará de Michelle y luego se casará con ella y Marisela se marcha muy alegre pero después decide que eso nunca será posible porque él es un doctor y ella muy poca cosa. Michelle le exige a Flavia que se divorcie de su padre porque él no la quiere y tiene una amante. Berta está furiosa con Armando por haberla dejado sola pero se ilusiona pensando que cuando sea su esposa las cosas cambiarán porque ella impondrá sus condiciones. Marisela sueña y en su sueño ve a Armando Malavé como su padre y se despierta desesperada y no puede creer que eso sea verdad.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Alejandro se entera de que Abril sabe la razón por la cual Inmaculada lo dejó plantado en el altar pero no le quiere decir y le responde que le pregunta el motivo a Inmaculada. Alejandro también se da cuenta de que su padre, Ángel sabe algo pero este tampoco le quiere contar nada. El peludo le regala un auto a Pelusa y le dice que como el corre riesgo de muerte quiere dejar toda su fortuna a nombre de ella. Pelusa ve a Josué trabajando en una obra en construcción pero luego se aleja y se va en su camioneta nueva sin hablar con él.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 63: El plan de Don Carlos
programme.desc: Socorro evade a Josefina diciéndole que pronto le presentará al hombre con quien está, así que Josefina se retira de la habitación, pero en seguida intenta sobornar a Helena para que le diga el nombre del novio de Cocó, sin embargo Helena no cede ante el dinero. Socorro le insiste a Salvador que le digan a Josefina sobre su relación, pues ella y su padre son de origen humilde y está segura que los apoyarán, pero Salvador no está de acuerdo, él está convencido que Josefina los va a separar.Don Carlos les ordena a sus escoltas que arroyen a Salvador, pero lejos de la presencia de María para que ella no sufra.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 63: Celos, Descubrimientos y Gran Impacto
programme.desc: Gabriel se deja invadir por los celos acrecentando aun mas su desconfianza en contra de Marisela al ver a esta en compañía de Reynaldo. El padre Venancio ayuda a Jesús a reincorporarse en su silla de ruedas al este informarlo sobre su gran error tras haber alertado a Ricardo de la gran fortuna que le fue despojada a su esposa tras ser heredera del difunto Ricardo. Alfonso descubre en Brillante un alma similar en gustos y perversidad al recibir de ella un estrafalario obsequio. Al estar acompañada por sus compañeros de universidad, Gabriela se ve victima de un gran impacto al ser informada por Giancarlos y sus amigos de la verdadera condición social y económica de su novio Ricardo.
